nodes.label: Chart: Primary Extinction Category Shift, Without vs With Rebase — dumbbell plot comparing percentage of simulation trials per extinction category (Biosphere Collapse, AI Misalignment, Runaway Molecular Manufacturing, Natural Disaster, Engineered Pathogen Release, Nuclear Exchange, Other) between a 'Without Rebase' and 'With Rebase' condition; Rebase sharply increases Biosphere Collapse (+35.0%) and AI Misalignment (+17.0%) share while sharply decreasing Nuclear Exchange (-58.2%); footnote notes representative sample of 60k of 2.4M trials, tying it to the novel's simulated civilization-trial dataset
